svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Core: cut 2,218 mm of 50 x 2 tube; ends square, deburred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plugs (2): turn 46 mm outside, 20 long, 20 mm bore, from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm bar; press into each core end flush, retaining compound

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and two M5 screws through the tube into each plug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper shaft: 20 mm steel, 76 long; 20 into the upper plug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower shaft: 120 long, 20 mm for 83 (20 in the plug), then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 mm for 37 at the outer end, with a 5 mm key flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press both shafts into the plugs with retaining compound.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide on the microfiber sleeve (2,198 long), 10 in from each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: core end; a hose clip on each end holds it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: spin it between centres: run-out under 1 mm.
